scope: Local offline Windows delivery using synthetic experiments and independent temporary data
limitations: No real SXRD files were read or matched.
No new live GitHub synchronization or GitHub CI was executed.
Windows executable is not code signed.
Verification covers software behavior, not scientific conclusions.

packagedScenarios.title: Windows desktop: plan → notes/problem/image → finish → export → complete backup and restore

unfinished operation and immediate note flush survive normal close and abrupt exit
failed save retains input, shows failure and can retry through the desktop boundary
workspace shortcuts, quantity guidance and clear search keep the workflow predictable
operation duration uses recorded timestamps across midnight, corrections and restart
keyboard operation, small window and display zoom keep current controls usable
live UI: double click, spare activation, remeasurement, skip, interruption and time correction
quick entry and dimensions → real PDF/HTML report; compact plan and cloud controls
